label: M1_mode7_low_rtp
_note: M1 mode 7 target v3 (2026-04-24) — TDD archetype rebuild. Dropped per_reel_symbol_targets (was fabricated pattern). Physical layout locked to Hot Roll 22-stop reel; this target is RTP/hit/bucket only. See reel_strips.json._archetype.
Mode 7 = low-RTP mode (~80% RTP). Mode 1's 'turbulent' counterpart.
Design brief (user 2026-04-22):
v1: RTP ~80%. Cut hit + low-multiplier wins from mode 1. Preserve mid/high.
v2 follow-up: 'mode 7 的中奖率砍半太过分了, 砍到 10% 差不多' — hit rate 7.8% was too aggressive, aim for ~10%.

Math: mode 1 is 94.3% RTP / 15.5% hit. To land at ~10% hit / ~82% RTP, we ease back Cherry + mixed-Bar (which were cut too far in v1) while still keeping them below mode 1's levels. Mid/high absolute pp stays preserved.
Budget — ~82% RTP, ~10% hit:
ge1_lt5 (Cherry):              5.0%   → 5.50pp  (6.8% of RTP)   ← bumped from v1's 3.0%
ge5_lt10 (mixed 3-Bar 5×):     1.5%   → 7.50pp  (9.3%)          ← unchanged from v1
ge10_lt20 (3 Bar1/Bar2):       2.0%   → 25.0pp  (31.0%)         ← preserved
ge50_lt100 (Bar + wild):       0.15%  → 10.5pp  (13.0%)         ← preserved
ge200_lt500 (Seven + wild):    0.005% → 1.40pp  (1.7%)          ← preserved
sum hit ≈ 9.68%, sum RTP ≈ 83pp
RTP contribution shares:
Low (1-10×):       13.0pp (15.7%)  — Cherry eased back to 5% hit (mode 1 had 10%)
Mid (10-50×):      55.0pp (66.3%)  — preserved in absolute pp (mode 1 had 59pp)
**High (50-500×): 15.2pp (18.3%)** — preserved; 7 hits still rare events

Player feel: hit rate ~10% means players see a win every ~10 spins (mode 1 is every ~6.5 spins, v1 was every ~13). Still noticeably more 'grindy' than mode 1 but not punishing — cherry still fires at a reasonable base-line cadence. Mid/high wins identical in frequency to mode 1, giving mode 7 its distinct 'less small wins, same big-win dynamics' signature.
CV projected ~ 5.9 (between mode 1's 5.06 and v1's 6.31). Volatility preserved relative to mode 1 but not as extreme as v1.
Strips are SHARED with mode 1/2/5 (file layout invariant). Only weights differ.
NOTE (2026-04-22 v3): This target file is superseded by direct scaling.
mode 7 is now derived as `mode 1 × (Cherry × 0.5, Bar × 0.9)` — see
mode_7/NOTES.md for rationale. The tuner pareto'd Seven1 down to near-zero
on two separate tune attempts (v1 hit-target 7.68%, v2 hit-target 9.68%),
violating the 'preserve mid/high wins' brief. Direct scaling gives
Seven family RTP share 6.60% (up from mode 1's 5.21% — what the user
asked for). Target file retained for reference / future re-evaluation.
_bucket_rate_rationale: ge10_lt20 / ge20_lt50 / ge50_lt100 / ge100_lt200 / ge200_lt500 all set to mode 1's analytic rates exactly.
This makes the target SELF-CONSISTENT with 'preserve mid/high wins' — the tuner starting from mode 1 weights has zero incentive to move these buckets.
ge1_lt5 and ge5_lt10 are the ONLY cut buckets (Cherry + mixed-Bar).
